sections.title: What changed
items: Rewind works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: The app is unchanged; taking this update seeds its wiki — vision, requirements, plan, lessons, next tasks, and the verbatim build prompt — into copies that predate doc seeding.

sections.title: What's new
items: Your listening, understood — portraits and trends Spotify forgets.
Connects to Spotify with an approval you walk through step by step; no password is ever shared.
